Subject: MAP sprint reprofile — holdback removal & go/no-go checklist

Alicia / Procurement,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is an updated MAP (MAP_v2_Helion.xlsx) that shows the condensed evaluation sprint and the proposed conditional holdback removal path. Key points: 

- New target acceptance window: week of 2027-06-28 (previously mid-July).
- Short pilot (3 days) to validate integrations and performance in your staging environment.
- Conditional holdback removal requires receipt of (1) SOC2 evidence packet and (2) signed pilot PO.

Immediate asks:
1) Can procurement confirm whether the PO stub (I attached in the follow-up) can be executed for a limited pilot?
2) If SOC2 evidence is sufficient, will procurement remove the 30% holdback for the pilot milestone only?

I listed the go/no-go checklist in the MAP tab. If helpful, we can escalate this to an exec quick-call — Marissa, Karthik, happy to join.

Attachments: MAP_v2_Helion.xlsx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@helionhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP sprint reprofile — holdback removal & go/no-go checklist

Vanessa,

Appreciate the update and the file. We are open to doing a short pilot but procurement will not remove a holdback without the SOC2 artifact set and a clear acceptance checklist that ties to our security gating. Specifically we need: 

- SOC2 report (Type II preferred) or equivalent evidence of controls.
- Data flow diagram for the pilot environment and confirmation of encryption-at-rest (KMS).
- A named contact in Redwood for audit questions.

Timeline constraints: our procurement queue is tight this month. If you can deliver SOC2 evidence by 2027-06-22 and confirm a pilot PO, we can attempt to move the pilot through procurement for a target start 2027-06-28. If evidence slips past 6/22, our earliest procurement window will likely slide to early July.

I'll loop in Procurement explicitly on next steps (Procurement Team).

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Director, Digital Platforms
Helion Health
agomez@helionhealth.com

Forwarding Alicia's note and adding a quick risk register & recommended rebaseline. Quoting Alicia below for context.

--- Forwarded message ---
On Tue, 15 Jun 2027 at 11:03 AM Alicia Gomez <agomez@helionhealth.com> wrote:
> Vanessa,
> 
> Appreciate the update and the file...

Risk register (top lines):
- R1: SOC2 evidence delayed -> procurement holdback remains -> pilot cannot start as scheduled. Mitigation: provide SOC2 packet + 3rd party attestation extract; offer a temporary engineering-only pilot contract with limited scope.
- R2: Procurement PO processing backlog -> start date pushed -> resource contention. Mitigation: request procurement expedite lane; provide PO stub and signatory delegation.
- R3: Integration snag in Helion staging -> acceptance fails -> rollback window needed. Mitigation: allocate 2-day contingency and define rollback criteria in MAP.

Recommendation (short):
1) Commit to delivering SOC2 evidence by 2027-06-22 (internal action: Marissa to assemble and validate).
2) Offer a pilot PO with a capped value and a single pilot milestone to reduce procurement friction.
3) If procurement cannot commit to removal of holdback for pilot, escalate to CS execs on 2027-06-18 for decision.

Can we target a sync Friday 6/18 at 11am PT to confirm escalation gating? Vanessa / Karthik pls confirm availability.

- Marissa
Director, Customer Success
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@helionhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@helionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP sprint reprofile — holdback removal & go/no-go checklist

Alicia / team,

Thanks for the clarity. We can support Helion on an accelerated path. Proposed mitigations and commitments:

- SOC2 packet delivery: Redwood will assemble the evidence bundle (report extract, control summaries, KMS configuration screenshots) and deliver by EOD 2027-06-22. Marissa will lead.
- Pilot PO: we'll sign a capped-value PO for the pilot (PO stub attached in previous email). If Procurement accepts the pilot PO, Redwood will commit to a 3-day pilot window starting 2027-06-28 and a rollback plan.
- Engineering support: Redwood will provision a dedicated engineer-as-point-of-contact for integration (name: Samir Patel). Samir will be reachable during the pilot and on-call for two business days after pilot conclusion.

Contingency if SOC2 slips: offer a temporary escrow — we can provide a 7% credit against the pilot milestone while evidence is collected, to reduce financial holdback friction. We'd prefer to avoid credits if possible, but this is on the table.

Next steps: Alicia, can Procurement confirm whether a capped pilot PO will be accepted into an expedited lane? If so, we'll queue DocuSign for the pilot PO and share the HubSpot deal update (HLN-3421).

-Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales Engineering
